source_detail: Built in ca-tools 2026-11-10 from the table's own CA(66;4,38,2) (Paley matrix for q = 37 doubled, rows deleted; submission smolen-2026-11-debate11). Columns 19, 32, 9 and 16 are dropped (the choice that leaves the three lightest rows with the fewest patterns only they cover). Then rows are removed one at a time, each time the row that is the only cover of the fewest patterns, and the array is repaired by simulated annealing in which every cell may change, with exact counts on all 4-sets and a move that writes a missing pattern into the closest of a few random rows (programs/fa.c). 65 and 64 rows took seconds (programs/CA_64_4_34_2_start.txt is the 64-row array). 63 rows took repeated 30-minute runs at temperatures 0.50 to 0.65, each continued from the best state so far, with 5, then 3, then 2 patterns missing (programs/state_63_34_2holes.txt), and the last run reached 0 (command fa state_63_34_2holes.txt 4 0.60 1800 76 out.txt -A -m 8, 831 s). Exact check with ca_verify, all 4-sets
construction: Doubled Paley array for q = 37 with rows deleted, cut to 34 columns, three more rows removed one at a time with repair by simulated annealing on all cells
notes: ties the cited size 63 at k = 34; no Torres-Jimenez array is an ingredient or start
